newsitem.title: USA: Multi-Color to cut Cincinnati operations.
newsitem.headline: Multi-Color to cut Cincinnati operations.

text.p: Multi-Color Corp said on Thursday it will close the rotogravure department of its Cincinnati plant and lay off 17 employees.
The company will continue rotogravure production of labels at its plant in Scottsburg, Ind. The Cincinnati plant will continue to employ 41 people producing lithographic labels.
Multi-Color also reported net income of $931,000 for the first nine months of fiscal 1997, or $0.33 per share, on revenues of $35.7 million.
